text: ERDE AGRO ECOSYSTEMS PVT. LTD. About Erde Agro ERDE AGRO is a technology-driven agriculture company committed to transforming farming through innovation, sustainability, and smart agricultural solutions. We work closely with farmers, FPOs, agri-input companies, financial institutions, and market partners to build a strong and transparent agricultural ecosystem. Our focus is to improve farm productivity, profitability, and sustainability by providing integrated solutions such as soil testing, smart farm monitoring, crop advisory, farm digitization, supply chain management, input supply, and market linkages. At Erde Agro, we believe that empowered farmers create stronger agriculture and a better future. We work towards the ‘Capacity Building of FPO’s’ and ‘Supply Securities’ to our buyers. Why Erde Agro? Erde Agro Ecosystems provides multiple agriculture-related services and business solutions to Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs). These include direct input supply, satellite imagery and data services, crop insurance, soil testing, market linkage, finance and credit support, and digitally enabled farm-management solutions through the Farm App. Through these services, Erde Agro aims to support FPOs in improving their operations, connecting farmers with quality agricultural inputs and services, accessing markets and buyers, using technology for farm monitoring and management, accessing financial facilities, and creating sustainable revenue opportunities. The company works with various partners and organizations across input supply, market linkage, finance, soil testing and technology services. Direct Input Supply Erde Agro supports FPOs throu

unities. The company works with various partners and organizations across input supply, market linkage, finance, soil testing and technology services. Direct Input Supply Erde Agro supports FPOs through a direct input-supply model in partnership with organizations including IFFCO, BBSSL and Reliance. Through the FPO franchise and dealership model, FPOs can become authorized dealers or centres for agriculture-related products and services and provide farmers access to genuine and certified- quality agricultural inputs. The services available through this model include agricultural inputs, seeds, fertilizers, soil testing, finance and the Erde Agro Farm App. The model is intended to improve farmers' access to agricultural inputs and services while enabling FPOs to develop an agriculture-related business and service centre for their farmer members. Company Journey and Major Milestones Erde Agrotech LLP was established in 2019. In 2020, the company started 160 acres of organic farming for ITC in Gujarat and worked on organic practices and market linkage. In 2022, Erde Agro Ecosystems was established and contract-farming deals were made with Griffith Foods, Terova and Omniactive Health. In 2023, the company signed an MoU with Dudhsagar Dairy and an agreement with ATMA and SMART to support FPCs and FPOs in capacity building. In 2024, the company entered into agreements with Irriwatch-Hydrosat, validated the Irriwatch App, conducted Farm App trials with Olam Food and connected farmers with ITC's Fruits

n capacity building. In 2024, the company entered into agreements with Irriwatch-Hydrosat, validated the Irriwatch App, conducted Farm App trials with Olam Food and connected farmers with ITC's Fruits & Vegetables division. On 6 January 2025, the company's business models were registered and approved by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. In March 2025, the company entered into an agreement with Axis Bank, and in April 2025 it partnered with IFFCO and Reliance as Market Channel Partners. The profile also records partnerships related to IPM training, soil testing, technology, financial services and agricultural organizations, and states that by August 2025 dealerships had been provided to more than 365 FPOs across 12 states.
